title: ranalisma humile
intro: Ranalisma humile, commonly known as Marsh Arrowgrass, is a perennial aquatic plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ranalisma humile include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
